svg.title: Module 1 — Multi-tenant agent framework architecture
svg.desc: Flowchart showing how a browser request flows through brand config, FastAPI backend, agent loader, and ElevenLabs API

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What does the browser send to start a call in Module 1?')
sendPrompt('What does the FastAPI backend do in Module 1?')
g.text: Receives brand_id, routes to agent loader

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does the agent loader work in Module 1?')
g.text: Reads brand config, builds agent params

g.onclick: sendPrompt('What is in the Maya brand config?')
sendPrompt('What is in the Aria brand config?')
sendPrompt('What is in the Nova brand config?')
sendPrompt('Why does the signed URL pattern matter for enterprise security?')
g.text: API key stays server-side — never in browser

g.onclick: sendPrompt('How does ElevenLabs Conversational AI connect via signed URL?')
sendPrompt('What does the frontend show in the multi-tenant agent?')
g.text: Connects directly to ElevenLabs via signed URL
